item.text:
Dear Instructor,

Thank you for sharing the materials list for the workshop. I’m looking forward to participating, but I noticed that some of the terms are unfamiliar to me. Could you please clarify what type or size of cutting mat we should bring? I’m also unsure what a bone folder is and whether there is a particular kind or brand you recommend. If possible, a brief description or example photo would be very helpful, especially for participants who are new to these tools. I want to make sure I purchase or prepare the correct materials before the workshop. Thank you for your time and guidance—I appreciate your help and look forward to learning from you.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
